objects.name: Chipkin Example B-BBMD
objects.note: vendor 389 (Chipkin Automation Systems); instance configurable with --deviceID and the Object_Name with --deviceName (both at start-up; the heading shows the defaults). The stack rows are device-wide facts only the stack knows - the protocol version and revision it implements, the services and object types it was configured with (from the BACnetStack_SetServiceEnabled/AddObject calls this example makes), the live object list and address-binding table, and Database_Revision, which the stack starts at 0 and increments for each object added at start-up: it reads 8 (the Device and the seven objects main.cpp adds) and stays 8 in both run modes, because nothing creates, deletes or renames an object afterwards (commanding an output, writing or activating the Broadcast Distribution Table or BBMD_Accept_FD_Registrations, and foreign-device registrations change values, not the object database). The accepted rows are the stack's configured defaults for APDU limits, segmentation and system status; an application that answered them from its own constants could contradict the stack, so this example does not

objects.name: Vermilion
objects.note: BACnet/IP, and this Network Port is the BBMD: BACnetStack_SetBBMD makes it one and it reports BACnet_IP_Mode=bbmd instead of normal (normal when started with --no-bbmd); SetBBMD also enables the BBMD_Broadcast_Distribution_Table/BBMD_Foreign_Device_Table/BBMD_Accept_FD_Registrations properties (not in this table - they are IPv4-BBMD-conditional properties outside the base Network Port set of the stack's generic per-type property profile), which are stack-computed from the live BDT/FDT, not app-served. BBMD_Broadcast_Distribution_Table is writable (cl. 12.56.38; a write must keep this device's own entry, and takes effect on ReinitializeDevice ACTIVATE_CHANGES/WARMSTART, Changes_Pending reading TRUE until then); BBMD_Accept_FD_Registrations is writable as a pending change that ReinitializeDevice ACTIVATE_CHANGES/WARMSTART makes effective (cl. 12.56.39). Network_Type and Protocol_Level are set from BACnetStack_AddNetworkPortObject()'s arguments (IPv4, BACnet Application) at start-up, not a GetProperty callback like the object's other app-served rows; Changes_Pending is likewise computed and answered natively by the stack's Network Port object. Reliability has no fault condition this example detects, so it is accepted at the generic default (normal)
